page: Microsoft Azure NCC40ads_H100_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine belonging to the NCCads2023 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 40 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with an AMD processor. It is configured with 320.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes 1049 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. Despite the naming convention, the hardware configuration reports zero GPUs. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a cost efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance in a higher resource density class. The primary tradeoff is the lack of integrated GPU accelerators despite the family designation, alongside the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, local caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring dedicated CPU resources and substantial local SSD capacity.
